evidence_sources.rationale: Defines Plan's subject, non-mutating boundary, inputs, artifacts, layering, decomposition, evidence, gates, execution-entry projection, readiness proof, and downstream handoff.
Defines Invoke's lifecycle position, shared state, downstream owners, capability axes, global gates, and the distinction between authoring and execution authority.
Defines the canonical executable hierarchy, artifact ownership rules, SWU responsibility, split-file minimums, navigability, and execution-readiness blockers.
Provides the current Work Pack control fields, execution policy, entry state, closeout synchronization, task and SWU contracts, gate checks, and readiness bindings.
Defines the Plan-local projection of the L0-L3 decision model, promotion evidence, deferrals, and non-regression guardrails.
Defines medium/high-complexity wave choreography, planning controls, layer mapping, closure obligations, and DomainSpec derivation hooks.

Explicitly retires IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md as a current executable authority while preserving historical concepts such as delivery slices, dependency planning, implementation detail, SWUs, validation, and handoff.

The completed prior Plan package supplies historical domain evidence for validator-authoritative results, provenance resolution, fail-closed disagreement handling, atomic SWUs, recomposition, owner boundaries, append-only history, and superseding evidence; its executable status, receipts, selected units, and authority claims are not current.

facets.rationale: The bounded subject is the non-mutating Invoke Plan successor that converts approved, stable design intent into governed, execution-addressable planning artifacts without performing implementation or another lifecycle owner's work.

The inventory covers the layering lens, canonical Work Pack, slices, tasks, SWUs, implementation details, waves, execution choreography, shared context, validation, gaps, transport, and machine execution source.
The artifact hierarchy, one-parent SWU rule, task-to-wave membership, layer mapping, dependency ordering, source navigation, choreography boundary, and canonical-source precedence are explicit.

The artifact distinguishes authored declarations from owner-derived evidence, classifies target and validation timing, binds current bytes by digest, preserves gaps and state, invalidates stale proofs, and treats historical execution claims as reassessment evidence only.

Activation, complexity, implementation-detail, atomicity, narrow-first-unit, Distill, navigation, closeout, WPRA, Implementation Readiness, contradiction, and mutation-handoff gates are separately represented.

The finite frontier, exact allowed routes, admission timing, entry state, typed validation contracts, one-SWU handoff, closeout synchronization, retry limit, successor policy, and execution-time context generation are represented.

Invoke Plan owns planning projections and current planning state; Design, Distill, WPRA, Implementation Readiness, Decision Gate, Context Builder, Task Session, Refresh, Spellcraft, Sigil Development, registry release, and runtime readiness retain their own authority.
